name: WonderSearch Discovery Collection
description: A child-friendly miniature internet of discoveries, activities, picture collections and playful learning for ages 5–7.

websites.name: Animal World
websites.tagline: Meet amazing creatures from every corner of our planet.
websites.description: A lively wildlife magazine full of animal stories, habitats, picture collections and gentle nature challenges.

websites.name: Space Explorer
websites.tagline: Big adventures beyond our little blue planet.
websites.description: A friendly space journal exploring planets, stars, astronauts, rockets and the wonders of the night sky.

websites.name: Ocean Discovery
websites.tagline: Dive beneath the waves and see who lives there.
websites.description: An underwater field guide with sea-life galleries, ocean facts and activities about protecting watery habitats.

websites.name: Fun Learning
websites.tagline: Little questions can lead to big discoveries.
websites.description: A playful learning hub for simple science, number puzzles, word games and curious experiments.

websites.name: Nature Club
websites.tagline: Step outside and explore the living world.
websites.description: A nature notebook about plants, weather, habitats, Earth science and small ways to care for our world.

websites.name: History Time
websites.tagline: Travel through time to discover how people lived.
websites.description: A child-friendly history museum featuring ancient places, everyday life, inventions and remarkable discoveries.

websites.name: Creative Corner
websites.tagline: Make, draw, imagine and try something new.
websites.description: An imaginative studio packed with art ideas, colour discoveries, patterns, crafts and creative challenges.

websites.name: Little Inventors
websites.tagline: Find out how things work, then dream up something new.
websites.description: A hands-on technology workshop exploring computers, machines, robots, simple tools and brilliant inventions.

entries.title: Lions: Kings of the Grasslands
entries.description: Meet powerful lions, learn how their family groups work and discover why they rest in the shade.

entries.title: Elephants Have Amazing Trunks
entries.description: An elephant uses its long trunk to smell, drink, pick up food and greet its family.

entries.title: Penguin Parade
entries.description: waddling penguins are brilliant swimmers, and their feathers help keep them warm in chilly places.

entries.title: Dolphins Talk Underwater
entries.description: Discover how dolphins use clicks and whistles, leap through waves and work together in groups.

entries.title: Pandas and Their Bamboo Snacks
entries.description: Find out why giant pandas spend much of the day eating bamboo in mountain forests.

entries.title: Butterfly Life Cycle
entries.description: Follow a tiny egg as it becomes a caterpillar, forms a chrysalis and emerges as a butterfly.

entries.title: Busy Bees at Work
entries.description: Visit a flower-filled garden and learn how bees collect nectar and help plants make seeds.

entries.title: Sharks: Ocean Super Swimmers
entries.description: Meet different sharks and learn that these fish have skeletons made from cartilage, not bone.

entries.title: Dinosaur Discovery: Meet the Giants
entries.description: Travel to prehistoric times to meet plant-eating and meat-eating dinosaurs from long ago.

entries.title: Tyrannosaurus Rex: The T. Rex
entries.description: Discover the famous T. rex, with tiny arms, strong legs and a powerful bite.

entries.title: Triceratops: Three-Horned Dinosaur
entries.description: Look closely at Triceratops, a plant-eating dinosaur with three horns and a large neck frill.

entries.title: Fossils: Clues from Long Ago
entries.description: See how bones, shells and footprints can become fossils that help us learn about ancient life.

entries.title: Animal Homes Around the World
entries.description: Explore nests, burrows, dens and hives, and match each animal to a place where it lives.

entries.title: Who Left These Tracks?
entries.description: Become a nature detective and match animal footprints to the creatures that made them.

entries.title: Our Solar System
entries.description: Take a tour of the Sun and its eight planets, from speedy Mercury to distant Neptune.

entries.title: Mars: The Red Planet
entries.description: Why does Mars look red? Explore its dusty surface, giant volcano and robot visitors.

entries.title: Jupiter: The Biggest Planet
entries.description: Meet the largest planet in our Solar System and spot its enormous swirling storm.

entries.title: Saturn's Beautiful Rings
entries.description: Discover Saturn's rings, made from countless pieces of ice and rock orbiting the planet.

entries.title: The Moon: Our Neighbour in Space
entries.description: Look at the Moon's changing shape and learn why it seems to shine at night.

entries.title: The Sun Is a Star
entries.description: Learn how our star gives Earth light and warmth, and why we must never look directly at it.

entries.title: Twinkling Stars and Constellations
entries.description: Look up at the night sky and join bright stars into patterns called constellations.

entries.title: What Is a Black Hole?
entries.description: Discover a place in space where gravity is so strong that even light cannot escape.

entries.title: Astronaut Training
entries.description: Try the gentle challenges astronauts practise before travelling into space.

entries.title: How Do Rockets Fly?
entries.description: Explore how rockets push hot gases downwards to travel upwards into space.

entries.title: Earth from Space
entries.description: See our blue planet from above and notice its oceans, clouds and green land.

entries.title: The Milky Way Galaxy
entries.description: Our Solar System lives inside a huge galaxy filled with stars, gas and dust.

entries.title: Make a Moon Crater Model
entries.description: Use flour and small soft balls to model how round craters can form on the Moon.

entries.title: Space Picture Quiz
entries.description: Test your space spotting skills with planets, rockets, stars and astronaut clues.

entries.title: A Tour of the Ocean Zones
entries.description: Travel from sunny surface waters to the deep sea and discover how ocean life changes.

entries.title: Sharks: Not All the Same
entries.description: Compare tiny and enormous sharks and discover what makes each one special.

entries.title: Dolphins and Their Clicks
entries.description: Listen in on the underwater world of dolphins and learn how sound helps them find things.

entries.title: Octopus: Eight Clever Arms
entries.description: Meet a clever octopus that can squeeze through small spaces and change its colour.

entries.title: Sea Turtles on the Move
entries.description: Follow sea turtles as they swim through oceans and return to sandy beaches to lay eggs.

entries.title: Coral Reefs: Busy Underwater Cities
entries.description: Explore colourful coral reefs where fish, crabs and many other creatures find food and shelter.

entries.title: Jellyfish: Drifters of the Sea
entries.description: Discover how jellyfish drift with ocean currents and use stinging tentacles to catch food.

entries.title: Penguins: Birds That Swim
entries.description: See how penguins use their flipper-like wings to zoom through cold ocean water.

entries.title: The Giant Blue Whale
entries.description: Meet the biggest animal known to have lived on Earth and learn how it eats tiny krill.

entries.title: Tide Pools: Tiny Ocean Worlds
entries.description: Peer into rock pools to find small crabs, snails, sea anemones and other hidden life.

entries.title: Why Is the Sea Salty?
entries.description: Find out how tiny bits of minerals travel from rocks and rivers into the sea.

entries.title: Keep Our Beaches Clean
entries.description: Try a beach-care challenge and learn how litter can harm animals that live near the sea.

entries.title: Build a Food Chain Under the Sea
entries.description: Put sea plants and animals in the right order to show how energy moves through an ocean food chain.

entries.title: Underwater Creature Match
entries.description: Match ocean animals to their pictures, homes and interesting features.

entries.title: Why Do Rainbows Appear?
entries.description: Sunlight and raindrops work together to make a colourful rainbow in the sky.

entries.title: Magnets: What Do They Attract?
entries.description: Test which everyday materials a magnet can pull towards it, and which ones it cannot.

entries.title: Gravity Keeps Us on the Ground
entries.description: Explore the invisible pull that makes dropped objects fall towards Earth.

entries.title: Light and Shadows
entries.description: Make a shadow puppet and discover how light travels and objects block it.

entries.title: The Five Senses
entries.description: Explore how eyes, ears, nose, tongue and skin help us notice the world.

entries.title: The Water Cycle
entries.description: Follow water as it warms, rises into the air, forms clouds and falls as rain.

entries.title: Electricity: Powering a Light
entries.description: Learn how electricity helps lamps, toys and other devices work safely.

entries.title: Number Patterns Puzzle
entries.description: Spot the rule in each number pattern and choose what should come next.

entries.title: Shapes Are Everywhere
entries.description: Find circles, squares, triangles, rectangles and other shapes in everyday objects.

entries.title: Measure It! Longer or Shorter?
entries.description: Compare the length and height of familiar objects using simple measuring ideas.

entries.title: Word Detectives: Rhyming Words
entries.description: Play with words that have matching end sounds and make a silly rhyme of your own.

entries.title: Punctuation Makes Meaning
entries.description: Meet full stops, question marks and exclamation marks in short, funny sentences.

entries.title: Which Materials Bend or Stretch?
entries.description: Investigate how rubber, paper, fabric and other materials behave when gently tested.

entries.title: Brain Teaser: The Odd One Out
entries.description: Look carefully at pictures and words, then explain which one does not belong.

entries.title: How Do Trees Grow?
entries.description: Explore roots, trunks, branches and leaves, and learn how trees make their own food.

entries.title: A Seed's Big Adventure
entries.description: Watch a seed sprout roots and shoots before growing into a young plant.

entries.title: Wildflowers in a Meadow
entries.description: Meet daisies, poppies and buttercups, and discover the insects that visit their flowers.

entries.title: Why Do Leaves Change Colour?
entries.description: Discover why many trees turn golden, orange and red before their leaves fall in autumn.

entries.title: Cloud Spotter's Guide
entries.description: Look for fluffy cumulus, thin wispy cirrus and grey rain clouds in the sky.

entries.title: Where Does Rain Come From?
entries.description: Learn how water vapour cools inside clouds and falls as tiny drops of rain.

entries.title: Wind: Air on the Move
entries.description: Make a simple wind streamer and notice how moving air can push and turn things.

entries.title: Volcanoes: Mountains That Can Erupt
entries.description: Discover how some mountains release hot melted rock, ash and gases from inside Earth.

entries.title: Mountains, Rivers and Valleys
entries.description: Explore how high mountains, flowing rivers and changing land create different landscapes.

entries.title: Deserts Are Full of Life
entries.description: Meet plants and animals with clever ways to live where rain is scarce.

entries.title: The World's Seven Continents
entries.description: Find the seven continents on a map and compare their shapes and locations.

entries.title: Recycle, Reuse, Repair
entries.description: Sort everyday materials and discover small ways to make less rubbish.

entries.title: Forest Layers: From Floor to Canopy
entries.description: Look from the shady forest floor up to the leafy canopy where many animals live.

entries.title: Make a Mini Nature Journal
entries.description: Start a picture journal of leaves, clouds and tiny things you notice outdoors.

entries.title: A Day in Ancient Egypt
entries.description: Visit the River Nile and discover homes, boats, farming and daily life in ancient Egypt.

entries.title: How Were the Pyramids Built?
entries.description: Explore the huge stone structures built in ancient Egypt and the people who made them.

entries.title: The Ancient Greeks
entries.description: Meet the people of ancient Greece and explore their stories, buildings, games and ideas.

entries.title: The First Olympic Games
entries.description: Travel back to ancient Greece to learn about the early sporting games at Olympia.

entries.title: Castles: Homes Made of Stone
entries.description: Explore castle towers, walls, drawbridges and the people who lived and worked inside.

entries.title: A Medieval Market Day
entries.description: Imagine a busy market with bakers, makers, traders and people buying useful goods.

entries.title: The Great Fire of London
entries.description: Learn how a fire changed parts of London in 1666 and how the city was rebuilt.

entries.title: Who Invented the Printing Press?
entries.description: Discover how printing books helped ideas and stories travel to more people.

entries.title: The First Trains
entries.description: See how steam engines helped people and goods travel along railway tracks.

entries.title: A Timeline of Transport
entries.description: Travel from early boats and carts to bicycles, trains, cars and aeroplanes.

entries.title: How Did People Send Messages?
entries.description: Explore messengers, letters, post horns and the ways people shared news long ago.

entries.title: The First People and Cave Art
entries.description: Look at ancient cave paintings and think about what they can tell us about the past.

entries.title: A Visit to a Roman Villa
entries.description: Step inside a Roman home and discover its rooms, mosaics, gardens and heating.

entries.title: History Detective: Then and Now
entries.description: Compare objects from the past with things we use today and spot what has changed.

entries.title: The Colour Wheel
entries.description: Mix and arrange colours to see how red, yellow and blue can make new shades.

entries.title: Warm and Cool Colours
entries.description: Sort sunny reds and oranges from cool blues and greens, then make a colour picture.

entries.title: Draw a Dinosaur Step by Step
entries.description: Use simple shapes to sketch a friendly dinosaur, then add spots, scales or stripes.

entries.title: Make a Paper Collage
entries.description: Cut or tear paper shapes and arrange them into a picture of your own design.

entries.title: Patterns in Nature
entries.description: Find repeating patterns in shells, leaves, flowers and animal markings.

entries.title: Symmetry: Two Sides Alike
entries.description: Fold, draw and decorate pictures to explore shapes that match on both sides.

entries.title: Make a Rainbow Spinner
entries.description: Create a spinning colour wheel and watch the colours blend as it turns.

entries.title: Build a Story with Pictures
entries.description: Choose a character, a place and a surprise to make your own little picture story.

entries.title: Sculpture with Safe Recycled Materials
entries.description: Turn clean cardboard tubes and boxes into a creature, tower or imaginary machine.

entries.title: Doodle Garden
entries.description: Fill a page with imaginary flowers, curling leaves, tiny bugs and playful patterns.

entries.title: Printmaking with Leaf Shapes
entries.description: Use leaf shapes and washable paint to make repeating prints on paper.

entries.title: Make a Colourful Flag
entries.description: Design a flag using shapes, colours and symbols that tell a story about an imaginary place.

entries.title: The Art of Mosaics
entries.description: Look at pictures made from many small pieces and design a simple paper mosaic.

entries.title: Creative Corner Challenge
entries.description: Try a quick creative prompt: invent a new creature and draw the home it would need.

entries.title: Meet the Parts of a Computer
entries.description: Discover the screen, keyboard, mouse and computer box, and what each part helps us do.

entries.title: Keyboard Explorer
entries.description: Find letters, numbers, the space bar and arrow keys on a computer keyboard.

entries.title: How Does a Computer Mouse Work?
entries.description: Practise moving a pointer, clicking and scrolling to explore a computer screen.

entries.title: What Is the Internet?
entries.description: Learn how computers can connect and share information, like a huge library of linked pages.

entries.title: Robots Help People
entries.description: Meet robots that explore distant places, build things and help with careful jobs.

entries.title: Give a Robot Clear Instructions
entries.description: Arrange simple steps to guide a pretend robot from the start to its goal.

entries.title: What Is an Algorithm?
entries.description: An algorithm is a set of steps, like a recipe, that helps solve a problem.

entries.title: Simple Machines Make Work Easier
entries.description: Explore levers, wheels, pulleys and ramps that help people move or lift things.

entries.title: Wheels Through Time
entries.description: Discover how the wheel changed travel, tools and the way people move heavy things.

entries.title: How Do Bridges Stay Up?
entries.description: Explore arches, beams and strong shapes that help bridges cross rivers and roads.

entries.title: Invent a Helpful Machine
entries.description: Sketch a machine that solves a small everyday problem, then label its parts.

entries.title: Digital Safety: Pause and Ask
entries.description: Learn simple rules for using a device with a trusted grown-up and keeping details private.

entries.title: How Do Cameras Make Pictures?
entries.description: Discover how a camera captures light to make a photograph you can look at later.

entries.title: Spot the Machine: Everyday Helpers
entries.description: Find machines at home and school, from washing machines to lifts and clocks.
